research_role: test one simple post-share-distribution drift engine economically distinct from Industry Diffusion, market-state timing, and low-risk selection

economic_hypothesis.mechanism: a completed bonus-share or capitalized-share distribution may create attention, ownership-base, and price-coordinate assimilation that drifts after the effective date
economic_hypothesis.independence: the event is an observed corporate-action coordinate change; it does not use Industry Diffusion, Low-MAX, market trend, support, candle, panic, or Champion membership
economic_hypothesis.data_boundary: QD-010 is PIT-B current-history evidence, but the strategy acts only after the recorded effective date has completed; it makes no historical-absence or strict PIT-A claim

frozen_strategy.event: QD-010 distribution with source_terms_complete == true and share_multiplier > 1
frozen_strategy.event_time: recorded effective-date completed close, only when known_at date is strictly earlier and the exact Cycle-015 causal eligibility row exists
frozen_strategy.selection: every eligible event stock on that effective date, sorted by symbol only; no distribution-ratio, return, industry, or liquidity rank
frozen_strategy.entry: next legal market-session open after the effective-date close; blocked names are not backfilled
frozen_strategy.holding: 20 market sessions from entry to due open, with unchanged QD-010 future-event pre-effective and legal-fill handling
frozen_strategy.event_capital: minimum of available cash and one-twentieth pre-entry NAV per distinct effective date
frozen_strategy.weights: equal across executable event stocks on the date

sequential_protocol.full_replay: run exact 2018-01-02 through 2023-12-29 only when both gates pass; no rule change

required_diagnostics: event and signal-date counts, completed trades, entry coverage and capital-skipped events
total and annualized return, maximum drawdown, Sharpe, Calmar and calendar returns
severe-loss incidence, turnover, breadth, industry concentration and capacity
daily-return correlation and signal-date overlap with frozen Industry-Consensus Q1
prohibited: distribution-ratio, bonus-versus-capitalized, cash-dividend, event-season, Top-N, holding-period, capital-divisor, or threshold search
announcement-date entry, same-effective-session fill, unresolved corporate-action coordinate, or historical-absence claim
stock return, momentum, Low-MAX, industry, support, candle, VWAP, panic, or post-shock recovery rank
validation outcome access before every generation requirement passes
combination with Strategy A before Strategy B independently passes
OOS, independent-confirmation, production, or live claim
